**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 07:22  
[FACT] User is analyzing website traffic data for a new product launch.  
[FACT] User is having trouble setting up a dashboard in Google Analytics to track conversions.  
[FACT] User has been taking online courses through Coursera to improve data analysis skills, specifically in Google Analytics and Excel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on taking the initiative to improve data analysis skills through Coursera courses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step process to set up a dashboard in Google Analytics to track conversions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Define conversion goals, including form submissions, purchases, downloads, button clicks, and specific page visits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Set up conversion tracking in Google Analytics by creating Goals in the Admin section.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Create a dashboard in Google Analytics by navigating to the Dashboards section and adding widgets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Customize the dashboard by adding multiple widgets, using filters, creating custom segments, and using annotations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Resources provided to help the user get started include Google Analytics Academy, Google Analytics Help Center, and Coursera's Google Analytics course.  
[USER] User found the assistant's information helpful and expressed understanding of the process.  
[USER] User asked how to set up the trigger for the goal, specifically for tracking form submissions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that to track form submissions, the user can use either Google Tag Manager (GTM) or Google Analytics event tracking code.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For GTM, the assistant provided a high-level overview of creating a tag and trigger for form submission events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Google Analytics event tracking code, the assistant provided an example of the code snippet to be added to the website's form submission handler.  
[USER] User decided to go with Option 1 using Google Tag Manager and requested a walkthrough for setting up the tag and trigger in GTM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed step-by-step guide for creating a new tag and trigger in GTM for the form submission event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Create a new tag in GTM for Google Analytics event tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Create a new trigger in GTM for form submission events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Link the tag to the trigger and publish the GTM container.
